description: Paid Ask The W MCP tools link Codex to your account for decisions, recaps, and server-side next moves.

defaultPrompt: Push this decision to Ask The W.
Retrieve my next moves from Ask The W.
Open Ask The W analytics and connected sources.
interface.longDescription: Use the paid Ask The W Codex plugin after install and workspace binding to send authorized, compact coding-session signals to your Ask The W account: capture setup, checkpoints, direction changes, implementation updates, verification results, and final summaries; push durable decisions; review scoped signal and decision history; request server-backed recaps; retrieve next moves from Ask The W; and open the workspace to review analytics and connected sources. Signals are sanitized by the MCP package before queueing or sending: no transcripts, secrets, credentials, private tokens, or large copied content. Examples: push a product or architecture decision made in Codex; pull the next moves already tracked in your Ask The W workspace; open Ask The W when you want the broader dashboard view.
interface.shortDescription: Account-linked Codex decisions, recaps, and server-side next moves.

name: askthew
